After you sync a new public job link, GitHub Actions tries to extract the posting title, employer, location, deadline and description from the page's structured metadata. Click Refresh tracker after the action finishes. This is not a general web search; eligibility and required documents still need review.

The tracker can save changes in this browser immediately. To synchronize with develop and your weekday reminders, connect GitHub with a fine-grained repository token. The token is held in memory for this tab only, never stored in files or browser storage.

This site and the tracker file are publicly accessible. Do not enter reference contact details, private confirmation numbers, personal credentials, or sensitive application information.

Add job postings

Paste one URL or several URLs on separate lines. Other fields are optional.

Sync with GitHub

GitHub Pages cannot edit the repository anonymously. To save directly to develop, use a fine-grained personal access token (recommended) restricted to WaseemRaza844/portfolio with Contents: Read and write. A classic token with the repo scope also works, but grants broader access.

Create one in GitHub token settings ↗. Do not paste it into ChatGPT or a repository file. It remains only in this page's memory and is cleared when you close or refresh the tab.
